K(x,z) = ∏\_\{j=0..d\sphinxhyphen{}1\} {[} ∑\_\{i=0\}\textasciicircum{}n 2\textasciicircum{}\{\sphinxhyphen{}2i\} He\_i(x\_j) He\_i(z\_j) * exp(\sphinxhyphen{}(x\_j\textasciicircum{}2+z\_j\textasciicircum{}2)/2) {]}

\end{description}

\item {}
